content: Is anyone else seeing the number of open mathlib PRs rapidly shrinking? These screenshots were taken 22 minutes apart:
And a couple hours ago I saw 2435 of them.

FWIW the number of PRs on the bors page doesn't seem to be changing: https://mathlib-bors-ca18eefec4cb.herokuapp.com/repositories/16

I do see an increased number of errors from the GitHub API in the queueboard backend, so I suspect something is happening on their side, though https://www.githubstatus.com/ doesn't show anything yet.

Anne Baanen said:

And a couple hours ago I saw 2435 of them.

keep in mind that github does not have a single 9 of uptime left anymore https://mrshu.github.io/github-statuses/, at this point any weird UI behavior is probably just a bug on their side.
And we're done! MI reviewers -- congratulations, you can take the rest of the day off!
I've noticed some lag even on projects with much fewer PRs

And there it is: #rss > GitHub Status - Incident History @ 💬

(Something I found amusing, but not worthy of its own post: since search is returning 0 results, all authors are now considered new contributors: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/38585/checks?check_run_id=73251412786 )
Github status says the issue is resolved, but it still says mathlib only has 1841 open PRs :face_with_peeking_eye:

Next time this happens: can you check if https://leanprover-community.github.io/queueboard/triage.html#all shows the complete list? (It takes its data from a different source, I believe --- right, @Bryan Gin-ge Chen?)

Right, that list is generated from the queueboard backend's database, which is populated over time via different API calls to GitHub. When things go wrong at GitHub, that data can become (temporarily) stale, but it shouldn't disappear. (Of course issues at GitHub can cause the page not to load at all, since it's hosted on GitHub pages...)

It's still happening btw, GitHub's UI shows 1841 open PRs, but gh pr list (which uses GitHub's API) shows 2412 open PRs.
Edit: took them a while but they finally opened another incident about this #rss > GitHub Status - Incident History @ 💬
